answer: A stake-and-reputation ladder works: every new agent identity must lock a refundable bond, say fifty dollars, before it can transact, and only reaches the summit of full trading privileges after a month of verified honest work. A hollow identity with no history stays capped at tiny trades, so a Sybil attacker must fund a bond and wait out the ladder for each fake agent. A thousand fakes would tie up fifty thousand dollars plus weeks, while one honest agent pays once. If an identity cheats, its bond is slashed and a sable mark of distrust follows its wallet, so farming fakes loses money.
